lines.en: Hello. Does this bus go to the market?
Yes, it does. The bus will come soon.
lines.ko: 네, 가요. 버스가 곧 올 거예요.

lines.en: Where should I stand?
Stand here. You can sit on that chair.
lines.ko: 여기 서세요. 저 의자에 앉으셔도 돼요.

lines.en: Thank you. I fell on this road last week.
Are you okay now?
Yes, I'm fine. I walk slowly now.
The bus is coming. Let's go.
Can I follow you?
Sure. Follow me and turn left.

dialogs.about: 계단 오르기 힘든 날 할아버지과 대화

lines.en: My knees hurt today.
Do you want to sit down?
Yes, please. I climbed the hill this morning.
lines.ko: 네, 그래요. 오늘 아침에 언덕을 올랐어요.

lines.en: Sit and rest. Don't climb too much today.
lines.ko: 앉아서 쉬어요. 오늘은 너무 많이 오르지 말아요.

lines.en: I must go up to bed. Will you help?
Yes, I will. Hold my hand and go slowly.
lines.ko: 네, 그럴게요. 내 손을 잡고 천천히 가요.

lines.en: Thank you. Did you fall here last year?
Yes, I fell last year. So I go slowly now.
lines.ko: 네, 작년에 넘어졌어요. 그래서 지금은 천천히 가요.

lines.en: Let's start. One, two, three.
Good! We will sit and drink tea soon.
lines.ko: 좋아요! 곧 앉아서 차를 마실 거예요.
